question: Where’s the closest hotel you hit on the way to River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail, River Edge, NJ from American Folk Art Museum, New York, NY?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%American Folk Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%River Edge Bird Sanctuary and Nature Trail%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%River Edge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), route_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry)::geography, 1000) AS buffered_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P, start_point s WHERE P.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT buffered_geom FROM route_buffer)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(s.geometry::geography, P.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
